LanguageData.IC_SettingsV03Construction: Research assimilation after Electricity, then build the pod in Architect > Misc. Cost: 120 steel, 6 industrial components, 4 industrial medicine; construction skill 6; power 400 W. No workbench recipe is needed.
LanguageData.IC_SettingsV03AssimilationDurationDesc: Multiplier of the duration in the pod definition. Default: 100% (one day for the standard pod). Range: 25–400%.
LanguageData.IC_SettingsV03BloodCostDesc: Biotech only. Multiplies the XML cost, rounded up to whole packs. Default: 100% (5 packs). Range: 0–200% (0–10 standard packs). For costs above 5, increase the tank refill target manually.
LanguageData.IC_SettingsV03RecoveryDurationDesc: Multiplier of post-assimilation physical recovery time. Default: 100%. Range: 25–400%. Does not erase permanent psychological or caste history.
LanguageData.IC_SettingsV03AllowRejuvenationDesc: Allow a lower biological age. If disabled, the transformation must not reduce biological age. Default: enabled.
LanguageData.IC_SettingsV03AllowRegrowBodyParts: Allow regrowth of missing body parts
LanguageData.IC_SettingsV03AllowRegrowBodyPartsDesc: Allow restoration of missing body parts. If disabled, preserve compatible missing parts; refuse an unsafe body mapping before transformation. Default: enabled.
LanguageData.IC_SettingsV03AllowCureDiseasesDesc: Allow removal of chronic diseases during transformation. If disabled, preserve compatible diseases; refuse unsafe transfers. Does not remove permanent caste history or conversion trauma. Default: enabled.
LanguageData.IC_SettingsV03PodEffectsDesc: Cosmetic intensity only, not psychological severity. 0% disables optional effects; progress and state indicators remain visible. Default: 100%. Range: 0–200%.
LanguageData.IC_SettingsV03Policy: Procedure duration, blood cost and medical permissions are captured when a procedure starts. Recovery duration is fixed for that procedure too. Later settings changes apply to new procedures. Visual effects may change immediately. Permanent caste history is never reset by these options.
LanguageData.IC_SettingsV03Reset: Reset all mod settings to defaults
